Deprecated dot.case function names

Source: R/zzz.R
legacy_aliases.Rd

The package originally used dot.case names. They are kept so that existing scripts keep working, but each call now warns once per session and forwards to its snake_case replacement. Use the new name in new code.

Usage

makeTransparent(...)

Get.batlow(...)

calc.moving.average(...)

basic.heatmap(...)

dendrogram(...)

convert.mouse.to.human(...)

convert.human.to.mouse(...)

GO.function(...)

UMAP.optimise(...)

clean.data.volcano(...)

colour.points.volcano(...)

alpha.points.volcano(...)

size.points.volcano(...)

custom.enhanced.volcano(...)

sc.correlation(...)

correlation.heatmaps(...)

download.TCGA.RNAseq(...)

TCGA.OS(...)

Arguments

...

Passed to the replacement function.

Value

The result of the replacement function.

Details

Old nameUse instead
makeTransparent()make_transparent()
Get.batlow()get_batlow()
calc.moving.average()moving_average()
basic.heatmap()basic_heatmap()
dendrogram()dendrogram_samples()
convert.mouse.to.human()convert_mouse_to_human()
convert.human.to.mouse()convert_human_to_mouse()
GO.function()go_enrichment()
UMAP.optimise()umap_optimise()
clean.data.volcano()clean_volcano_data()
colour.points.volcano()colour_volcano_points()
alpha.points.volcano()alpha_volcano_points()
size.points.volcano()size_volcano_points()
custom.enhanced.volcano()custom_enhanced_volcano()
sc.correlation()sc_correlation()
correlation.heatmaps()correlation_heatmaps()
download.TCGA.RNAseq()download_tcga_rnaseq()
TCGA.OS()tcga_survival()
